scopeDimensions.name: primary operator and buyer
scopeDimensions.decision: Compliance/GRC lead or small central team; accountable function owner is buyer/sponsor target; market validation remains not assessed.

scopeDimensions.name: must-win jobs
scopeDimensions.decision: Seven must-win jobs preserve basis, human authority, cross-process work, bounded evidence and verified closure without legal automation.

scopeDimensions.name: seven-process breadth
scopeDimensions.decision: Exactly seven peer business procedures; EP-01 remains cross-cutting; procedure disablement preserves history and evidence.

scopeDimensions.name: deployment topology
scopeDimensions.decision: Customer-controlled single node is primary; loopback default; networked/multi-tenant use remains bounded and conditional; no HA/public-bind claim.

scopeDimensions.name: scale and concurrency
scopeDimensions.decision: Workgroup design envelope: 50 named users/tenant, 10 simultaneous sessions/tenant, 5 tenants/node, 10k active records/tenant, write burst 5; unverified until REALITY/C3.

scopeDimensions.name: supported clients
scopeDimensions.decision: Evergreen Chromium desktop is primary; 390px responsive review/triage is secondary; cross-engine/native/offline/legacy support is out of target.

scopeDimensions.name: install/update/rollback support
scopeDimensions.decision: Versioned local bundle and ictc.sh; planned update/recovery/compatibility-aware rollback; no auto-updater or zero-downtime promise; provenance remains C2.

scopeDimensions.name: data sensitivity/residency
scopeDimensions.decision: Internal/confidential compliance and personal data may occur; customer-controlled local residency is primary; egress changes boundary; universal regulated suitability is not claimed.

scopeDimensions.name: availability/recovery/capacity
scopeDimensions.decision: Business-hours workbench with planned downtime; encrypted verified recovery required; no universal SLA/HA/RTO/RPO; deployment objectives remain E4.

scopeDimensions.name: integrations/master systems
scopeDimensions.decision: Manual/source-pack/external-reference intake, upstream identity, optional AI and same-as-read exports; external master authority retained; no required bidirectional sync.

scopeDimensions.name: roles/delegation/SoD
scopeDimensions.decision: Admin/user/auditor remain; delegation is ownership/assignee/tenant-membership; AI has no decision authority; organization-specific SoD is not universalized.

scopeDimensions.name: product success metrics
scopeDimensions.decision: Repository success uses structural E2 targets while representative time/task/comprehension/AT outcomes require E3; compliance/maturity/market-fit proxy scores are forbidden.

scopeDimensions.name: feature/architecture budget and non-goals
scopeDimensions.decision: Preserve Node/vanilla/Store/SQLite/one-root by default; structural rewrites require REALITY evidence plus DECIDE authority; no second store/global resolver/generic BPM by default.

realityAssessments.asIs: Compliance-lead and auditor professional lenses plus three runtime roles exist; buyer fit and representative operator validation are not repository facts.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: Preserve current role/persona model; require E3-HUMAN operator/task validation before broad operator-fit claims.

realityAssessments.asIs: Product journeys preserve original basis, human checkpoints, cross-process routing, evidence and verified closure while AI stays assistive.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: No structural rewrite indicated by this dimension.

realityAssessments.asIs: Exactly seven peer business procedures are canonical; EP-01 is cross-cutting and procedure disablement preserves history while blocking new work.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: Preserve seven peer procedures and cross-cutting EP-01.

realityAssessments.asIs: Loopback single-node is the default; optional multi-tenant and trusted-header network mode exist with server-side boundaries, while public bind, HA and production identity are not repository-proven.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: Keep single-node primary; networked deployment remains conditional on E4 identity/scanner controls.

realityAssessments.asIs: Serialized writes, abuse budgets, bounded pagination and historic stress mechanisms exist, but 50 users/tenant, 10 simultaneous sessions, 5 tenants/node and 10k active records/tenant are not end-to-end capacity benchmarks.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: C3-CAPACITY-CONTRACT must establish measured budgets before any scale claim; no datastore rewrite is justified yet.

realityAssessments.asIs: Canonical browser rails exercise Chromium-oriented desktop journeys and 390px responsive/a11y behavior; cross-engine and representative assistive-technology usability are outside repository proof.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: Retain bounded client target; E3-HUMAN remains required for assistive-technology and task effectiveness.

realityAssessments.asIs: The launcher, schema migration refusal, compatibility-aware rollback via pre-migration recovery point and recovery CLI are present, but delivery provenance/signing remains C2.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: Preserve recovery-based rollback semantics; close C2 before claiming governed delivery provenance.

realityAssessments.asIs: SQLite and tenant directories are customer-local by default; AI egress and attachment scanner boundaries are explicit, while universal regulated suitability is not claimed.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: Preserve local-first residency; treat AI/scanner/key custody as boundary-changing deployment controls.

realityAssessments.asIs: Encrypted, integrity-checked recovery points are implemented, but HA, off-host durability and approved RTO/RPO remain explicitly unproven and capacity is unverified.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: Do not introduce HA by assumption; E4 defines recovery objectives and C3 defines capacity.

realityAssessments.asIs: Manual/source-pack/external-reference intake, trusted upstream identity, optional AI and same-as-read exports preserve external master authority without mandatory bidirectional sync.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: No integration platform or marketplace is justified by current target.

realityAssessments.asIs: Admin/user/auditor are canonical; auditor mutation is denied by permission shape, tenant membership is server-side, and AI cannot acquire decision authority.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: Preserve three-role core; organization-specific SoD remains configuration/deployment policy rather than universal workflow.

realityAssessments.asIs: Repository gates can measure E2 structure and behavior, but representative task time, completion, comprehension, pleasantness and AT outcomes require E3-HUMAN evidence.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: Do not synthesize market-fit/compliance/maturity scores from CI; define human baselines externally.

realityAssessments.asIs: AS-IS is Node/vanilla/Store/SQLite with one composition root; no observed hard contradiction requires PostgreSQL, generic BPM, second store or global UI resolver.
realityAssessments.decisionInput: Preserve current architecture by default; any structural change needs explicit DECIDE-0 evidence/rationale.

claimBoundary: REALITY-0 classifies merged SCOPE-0 targets against repository/runtime AS-IS and hands evidence to DECIDE-0; it changes no business write authority, API, persistence or UI behavior. Capacity remains unverified for C3; provenance remains C2; GAP-020/GAP-021 stay open; E3-HUMAN, E3-GOV and E4-DEPLOY remain external; no enterprise-ready, legal/compliance, certification or market-fit conclusion.
